    local _ = Character.HumanoidRootPart;
    local Humanoid = Character.Humanoid;

    if script_Parent.cooldown.Value <= 0 and (u1 and LocalPlayer.Character.busyCasting.Value == false) then
        u1 = false;
        script_Parent.spellEvent:FireServer();
        local v2 = animationCache.load(Humanoid, spellAnim);

        v2:AdjustSpeed(3);
        Humanoid:UnequipTools();
        wait(Value);
        u1 = true;
    end;

    Character.Humanoid:UnequipTools();
end);

local function calculateWhatUpgradeTheyShouldBeOn(p72, p73) -- Line: 498
    -- upvalues: LocalPlayer (copy), calculateUpgradeCost (copy)
    local Value = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Gold.Value;
    local currentUpgrade = p72.currentUpgrade;
    local v74 = 0;

    for i = 1, p73 do
        local v75 = calculateUpgradeCost(currentUpgrade + (i - 1));

        if v75 >= Value then
            break;
        end;

        Value = Value - v75;
        v74 = v74 + 1;
        local _ = i;
    end;

    local v76 = currentUpgrade + v74;

    if p72.maxUpgrades < v76 then
        v76 = p72.maxUpgrades;
    end;

    return v76;
end;

local function upgradeClicked(p77) -- Line: 521
    -- upvalues: LocalPlayer (copy), getCertainItem (copy), chosenItem (copy), tenTimes (copy), spendAll (copy), errorSound (copy), calculateUpgradeCost (copy), calculateWhatUpgradeTheyShouldBeOn (copy), leftSide (copy)
    local v78 = LocalPlayer.busyTrading.Value == false and getCertainItem(game.ReplicatedStorage.remotes.reloadInvy:InvokeServer(), chosenItem.itemType.Value, chosenItem.itemType.uniqueItemNum.Value);

    if v78 then
        local v79 = nil;
        local v80 = 1;

        if tenTimes.Frame.privateInner.chosenIndicatorBackground.chosenIndicatorFill.chosen.Visible == true then
            v80 = 10;
            v79 = "10x";
        elseif spendAll.Frame.privateInner.chosenIndicatorBackground.chosenIndicatorFill.chosen.Visible == true then
            v80 = v78.maxUpgrades - v78.currentUpgrade;
            v79 = "spendAll";
        end;

        game.ReplicatedStorage.remotes.upgradeItem:FireServer(chosenItem.itemType.Value, chosenItem.itemType.uniqueItemNum.Value, p77, v80, v79);

        if p77 == "health" and chosenItem.itemType.Value == "weapon" then
            local v81 = game.ReplicatedStorage.ui.alert:Clone();
            v81.TextLabel.Text = "You cannot upgrade health on a weapon";
            v81.Parent = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.alertBox.Frame;
            local v82 = errorSound:Clone();
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(v82, 1);
            v82:Play();
            v82.Parent = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui;

            return;
        end;

        if v78.currentUpgrade < v78.maxUpgrades then
            if calculateUpgradeCost(v78.currentUpgrade) <= LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Gold.Value then
                local v83 = calculateWhatUpgradeTheyShouldBeOn(v78, v80);
                leftSide.chosenItem.itemType.Value = chosenItem.itemType.Value;
                leftSide.chosenItem.itemType.imageId.Value = v78.imageId;
                leftSide.backgroundName.itemName.Text = v78.name;
                leftSide.costMain.cost.Text = calculateUpgradeCost(v83);
                leftSide.upgradesMain.upgrades.Text = v83 .. "/" .. v78.maxUpgrades;

local function setRarityColorOfFrame(p54, p55) -- Line: 517
    local v56 = p54:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke");

    if p55 == "DEV" then
        if not v56 then
            v56 = Instance.new("UIStroke");
            v56.Name = "raritySwatchStroke";
            v56.Parent = p54;
        end;

        v56.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1);
        v56.Thickness = 2;
        v56.Enabled = true;
    elseif v56 then
        v56.Enabled = false;
    end;

    if p55 == "common" then
        p54.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.596078431372549, 0.596078431372549, 0.596078431372549);

        return;
    end;

    if p55 == "uncommon" then
        p54.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3568627450980392, 0.7607843137254902, 0.3137254901960784);

        return;
    end;

    if p55 == "rare" then
        p54.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.29411764705882354, 0.30196078431372547, 0.7647058823529411);

        return;
    end;

    if p55 == "epic" then
        p54.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.5725490196078431, 0.27450980392156865, 0.6235294117647059);

        return;
    end;

    if p55 == "legendary" then
        p54.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.9568627450980393, 0.6039215686274509, 0.03529411764705882);

        return;
    end;

    if p55 == "ultimate" then
        p54.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0);

        return;
    end;

    if p55 == "DEV" then
        p54.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0);
    end;
end;

local function inLobby() -- Line: 609
    -- upvalues: LocalPlayer (copy)
    for _, child in pairs(workspace.bossLobbies:GetChildren()) do
        for _, child2 in pairs(child.players:GetChildren()) do
            if LocalPlayer.Name == child2.Name then
                return "raid";
            end;
        end;
    end;

    local workspace_games = workspace.games;

    for _, child in pairs(workspace_games.inGame:GetChildren()) do
        for _, child2 in pairs(child:GetChildren()) do
            if child2.Name == LocalPlayer.Name then
                return "dungeon";
            end;
        end;
    end;

    for _, child in pairs(workspace_games.inLobby:GetChildren()) do
        for _, child2 in pairs(child:GetChildren()) do
            if child2.Name == LocalPlayer.Name then
                return "dungeon";
            end;
        end;
    end;

    return "none";
end;
